data.overview: Laifen is a consumer grooming-appliance brand (hair dryers, electric toothbrushes, shavers and beauty tools) that markets itself on product performance and a large user base. The only independent brand-specific evidence in the fetched sources is a 2025 Red Dot Design Award recognizing the recyclable, plant-fibre packaging of the Laifen Wave Electric Toothbrush, which also identifies the manufacturer as Dongguan Laifen Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. No independent safety, labour, cruelty-free or vegan assessments of the brand appear in the fetched sources.

claims.claim: Laifen states its Wave toothbrush packaging is recyclable and offers 360-degree product protection.
claims.quote: Laifen Wave Travel Case 0 Bulk Travel 360° Protection

papers.title: Red Dot Design Award: Laifen Wave Electric Toothbrush
papers.summary: Red Dot awarded the Laifen Wave Electric Toothbrush a 2025 Product Design award for its packaging, which is made from 100 per cent plant fibres and can be repurposed as a planter. The jury praised the recyclable packaging for combining ecological materials with minimalist design, functionality and aesthetics. The listing identifies the manufacturer as Dongguan Laifen Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.

findings.text: The toothbrush packaging is made entirely from plant fibres and can be reused as a planter, supporting a circular-economy concept.
findings.quote: Made from 100 per cent plant fibres, the box can be repurposed as a planter after unpacking and thus contributes to the concept of the circular economy.

findings.text: The jury judged that the packaging shows sustainable design can align with functionality and aesthetics.
findings.quote: The packaging of the Laifen Wave Electric Toothbrush impressively demonstrates how sustainable design can harmonise with functionality and aesthetics.

findings.text: The product is manufactured by Dongguan Laifen Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. in China.
findings.quote: Manufacturer Dongguan Laifen Electronic Technology Co., Ltd., Dongguan, China Design Shenzhen Shuye Technology Co., Ltd.
